turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighing) Honestly? Fine, I guess — why does it matter, you probably ask everyone that. What's the point of even talking about it, anyway?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I'm glad you're here and that you're willing to talk. It's important to acknowledge and validate each other's feelings. Can you tell me more about what's been going on and how you've been feeling?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (softening slightly) It's just...my roommate barely talked to me for two days and I could not stop thinking she was about to just leave, like pack up and go. It was like this...hollow feeling that just wouldn't go away. And then I started thinking about all the things I'd done wrong, and how I'm just so worthless... (looking down, voice barely above a whisper)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. It sounds like you're experiencing a lot of emotional distress and self-doubt. It's important to remember that everyone has their own struggles and it's okay to feel overwhelmed. Can you tell me more about what's been going on with your roommate and how that's been affecting you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (getting defensive) Oh, so you think it's all about communication, huh? Like I'm just not good at talking to people? You don't get it, do you? She's just...she's just not interested in me, and it's not about me being paranoid or not. It's just...she's just done with me, and that's it. (crossing arms, voice rising)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. It sounds like you're feeling a lot of frustration and hurt in this situation. It's important to remember that everyone has their own thoughts and feelings, and just because someone may not be interested in you doesn't mean they don't care about you. It's important to communicate your feelings and needs to your roommate in a calm and assertive manner. Can you tell me more about how you're communicating with her and what you need from her in this situation?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (getting dismissive) Oh, spare me the clichés. You think just because you say "prioritize my own well-being" and "communicate my feelings", it's going to magically fix everything? You don't get it. This isn't about some generic advice or formula. It's about her, and how she's treating me. (shrugging) Look, I don't even know why I'm still talking about this. It's not like it's going to change anything.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. It sounds like you're feeling frustrated and hopeless in this situation. It's important to remember that communication and setting boundaries are important in any relationship, and it's okay to express your feelings and needs to your roommate. Can you tell me more about what you need from her in this situation?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (getting angry) Oh, come on. You're not listening. I've already told you, she brushes me off and calls me paranoid. What more do you need to hear? It's not like I'm asking you to fix it or anything, just listen to me for once. (slamming fist on the armrest) I'm sick of being dismissed and ignored.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand that you're feeling frustrated and dismissed in this situation. It's important to remember that communication and setting boundaries are important in any relationship, and it's okay to express your feelings and needs to your roommate. Can you tell me more about what you need from her in this situation?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (getting up, looking at the therapist with a mix of anger and hurt) You know what? I've had enough of this conversation. I don't see how talking about this is going to help anything. You're just saying the same things over and over, and it's not fixing anything. (standing up, starting to walk towards the door) I'm done.

turns.text: (stopping in the doorway, still turned away from the therapist) You know, I'm not even sure why I'm still talking about this. It's not like you're getting it. You're just going through the motions, saying the same things you always say, and I'm just wasting my time. (shaking head and walking out of the room, not looking back)
